text.tspan: Mean income or consumption per day within each decile, 1963 to 2024
The mean income or consumption per person per day within each decile (tenth of the population). This data is
adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
Data source: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2026)

Note: This data is expressed in
international-$
at 2021 prices. Depending on the country and year, it relates to income (measured after taxes

and benefits) or to consumption,
per capita
.
